choose.when: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM period_activity_lesson WHERE period_activity_lesson.lesson_id = l.lesson_id )
choose.otherwise: ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM period_activity_lesson WHERE period_activity_lesson.lesson_id = l.lesson_id ) OR (l.create_time IS NOT NULL AND l.create_time >= #{q.startTime} AND l.create_time < #{q.endTime}) OR (l.create_time IS NULL AND l.update_time IS NOT NULL AND l.update_time >= #{q.startTime} AND l.update_time < #{q.endTime}) OR (l.create_time IS NULL AND l.update_time IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_lesson_class_scope period_scope WHERE period_scope.lesson_id = l.lesson_id AND COALESCE(period_scope.first_assigned_time, period_scope.last_assigned_time) >= #{q.startTime} AND COALESCE(period_scope.first_assigned_time, period_scope.last_assigned_time) < #{q.endTime} )) )

mapper.sql: scope_metric AS ( SELECT scope.lesson_id, COUNT(*) AS class_count FROM biz_lesson_class_scope scope INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id GROUP BY scope.lesson_id ), participant_metric AS ( SELECT activity.lesson_id, COUNT(DISTINCT activity.student_id) AS participant_count FROM period_activity activity INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = activity.lesson_id GROUP BY activity.lesson_id ), usage_metric AS ( SELECT lesson_id, MIN(usage_date) AS usage_date FROM class_usage_metric GROUP BY lesson_id ), practical_metric AS ( SELECT answer.lesson_id, COUNT(*) AS practical_due_count, SUM(answer.score IS NOT NULL) AS practical_graded_count FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id AND question.question_type = 'practical' WHERE answer.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(answer.student_answer) <> '' AND answer.submit_time >= #{q.activityStartTime} AND answer.submit_time < #{q.activityEndTime} GROUP BY answer.lesson_id ), deadline_metric AS ( SELECT deadline.lesson_id, MIN(deadline.current_deadline_time) AS nearest_deadline_time, SUM(deadline.current_deadline_time <= NOW()) AS overdue_class_count FROM biz_practical_grading_deadline deadline INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = deadline.lesson_id GROUP BY deadline.lesson_id )

student_lesson_pair AS ( SELECT answer.student_id, answer.lesson_id FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id GROUP BY answer.student_id, answer.lesson_id UNION SELECT performance.student_id, performance.lesson_id FROM biz_classroom_performance performance INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = performance.lesson_id GROUP BY performance.student_id, performance.lesson_id ), raw_homework AS ( SELECT answer.student_id, answer.lesson_id, SUM(IFNULL(answer.score, 0)) AS homework_score FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id GROUP BY answer.student_id, answer.lesson_id ), latest_adjustment AS ( SELECT adjustment.student_id, adjustment.lesson_id, adjustment.adjusted_homework_score, adjustment.action_type FROM biz_score_adjustment adjustment INNER JOIN ( SELECT student_id, lesson_id, MAX(adjustment_id) AS adjustment_id FROM biz_score_adjustment GROUP BY student_id, lesson_id ) latest ON latest.adjustment_id = adjustment.adjustment_id ), course_score AS ( SELECT pair.student_id, pair.lesson_id, lesson.dept_id, lesson.creator_id, CASE WHEN performance.is_absent = 1 OR lesson.lesson_mode = 'attendance' THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, CASE WHEN adjustment.action_type = 'UPDATE' THEN IFNULL(adjustment.adjusted_homework_score, 0) ELSE IFNULL(homework.homework_score, 0) END + IFNULL(performance.score, 0))) END AS final_score FROM student_lesson_pair pair INNER JOIN filtered_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = pair.lesson_id LEFT JOIN raw_homework homework ON homework.student_id = pair.student_id AND homework.lesson_id = pair.lesson_id LEFT JOIN latest_adjustment adjustment ON adjustment.student_id = pair.student_id AND adjustment.lesson_id = pair.lesson_id LEFT JOIN biz_classroom_performance performance ON performance.student_id = pair.student_id AND performance.lesson_id = pair.lesson_id ), school_score_metric AS ( SELECT dept_id, ROUND(AVG(final_score), 1) AS avg_total_score FROM course_score GROUP BY dept_id ), teacher_score_metric AS ( SELECT dept_id, creator_id, ROUND(AVG(final_score), 1) AS avg_total_score FROM course_score GROUP BY dept_id, creator_id )
mapper.select: WITH SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lesson.dept_id) FROM filtered_lesson lesson INNER JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = lesson.dept_id AND dept.del_flag = '0'

WITH , ,
SELECT dept.dept_id AS deptId, dept.dept_name AS deptName, dept.school_type AS schoolType, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, SUM(lesson.lesson_mode <> 'attendance') AS assessmentCourseCount, SUM(lesson.lesson_mode = 'attendance') AS attendanceCourseCount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(lesson.creator_id, lesson.create_by)) AS teacherCount, SUM(IFNULL(scope_metric.class_count, 0)) AS classCount, SUM(IFNULL(participant_metric.participant_count, 0)) AS participantCount, SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0)) AS practicalDueCount, SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0)) AS practicalGradedCount, SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0) - IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0)) AS practicalUngradedCount, ROUND( SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0)), 0), 1 ) AS gradingRate, SUM(IFNULL(deadline_metric.overdue_class_count, 0)) AS overdueClassCount, MAX(school_score_metric.avg_total_score) AS avgTotalScore FROM filtered_lesson lesson INNER JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = lesson.dept_id AND dept.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN scope_metric ON scope_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN participant_metric ON participant_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN practical_metric ON practical_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN deadline_metric ON deadline_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN school_score_metric ON school_score_metric.dept_id = lesson.dept_id GROUP BY dept.dept_id, dept.dept_name, dept.school_type ORDER BY courseCount DESC, dept.dept_name

WITH , ,
SELECT lesson.dept_id AS deptId, dept.dept_name AS deptName, lesson.creator_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(teacher.nick_name, lesson.create_by, '待治理') AS teacherName, COALESCE(teacher.user_name, lesson.create_by, '待治理') AS teacherUserName, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, SUM(lesson.lesson_mode <> 'attendance') AS assessmentCourseCount, SUM(lesson.lesson_mode = 'attendance') AS attendanceCourseCount, SUM(IFNULL(scope_metric.class_count, 0)) AS classCount, SUM(IFNULL(participant_metric.participant_count, 0)) AS participantCount, SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0)) AS practicalDueCount, SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0)) AS practicalGradedCount, SUM(IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0) - IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0)) AS practicalUngradedCount, MAX(teacher_score_metric.avg_total_score) AS avgTotalScore FROM filtered_lesson lesson INNER JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = lesson.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user teacher ON teacher.user_id = lesson.creator_id LEFT JOIN scope_metric ON scope_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN participant_metric ON participant_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN practical_metric ON practical_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN teacher_score_metric ON teacher_score_metric.dept_id = lesson.dept_id AND teacher_score_metric.creator_id <=> lesson.creator_id GROUP BY lesson.dept_id, dept.dept_name, lesson.creator_id, COALESCE(teacher.nick_name, lesson.create_by, '待治理'), COALESCE(teacher.user_name, lesson.create_by, '待治理') ORDER BY courseCount DESC, teacherName

WITH ,
SELECT lesson.lesson_id AS lessonId, lesson.lesson_title AS lessonTitle, lesson.lesson_mode AS lessonMode, lesson.entry_year AS entryYear, lesson.grade, lesson.semester, lesson.lesson_num AS lessonNum, lesson.create_time AS createTime, lesson.update_time AS updateTime, usage_metric.usage_date AS usageDate, lesson.dept_id AS deptId, dept.dept_name AS deptName, lesson.creator_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(teacher.nick_name, lesson.create_by, '待治理') AS teacherName, IFNULL(scope_metric.class_count, 0) AS classCount, IFNULL(participant_metric.participant_count, 0) AS participantCount, IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0) AS practicalDueCount, IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0) AS practicalGradedCount, IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_due_count, 0) - IFNULL(practical_metric.practical_graded_count, 0) AS practicalUngradedCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_lesson_question lq INNER JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = lq.question_id WHERE lq.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id AND q.question_type = 'practical') AS hasPractical, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_lesson_question lq WHERE lq.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id) AS questionCount, deadline_metric.nearest_deadline_time AS nearestDeadlineTime, IFNULL(deadline_metric.overdue_class_count, 0) AS overdueClassCount FROM filtered_lesson lesson INNER JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = lesson.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user teacher ON teacher.user_id = lesson.creator_id LEFT JOIN scope_metric ON scope_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN participant_metric ON participant_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN usage_metric ON usage_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN practical_metric ON practical_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id LEFT JOIN deadline_metric ON deadline_metric.lesson_id = lesson.lesson_id
ORDER BY usage_metric.usage_date IS NULL, usage_metric.usage_date ASC, lesson.lesson_id ASC
ORDER BY usage_metric.usage_date IS NULL, usage_metric.usage_date DESC, lesson.lesson_id DESC

SELECT question.question_id AS questionId, question.question_type AS questionType, question.question_content AS questionContent, lesson_question.question_score AS maxScore, lesson_question.order_num AS orderNum FROM biz_lesson_question lesson_question INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = lesson_question.question_id WHERE lesson_question.lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY lesson_question.order_num, lesson_question.id

SELECT answer.answer_id AS answerId, answer.question_id AS questionId, answer.student_id AS studentId, user.nick_name AS studentName, student.student_no AS studentNo, answer.student_answer AS studentAnswer, answer.preview_path AS previewPath, answer.preview_status AS previewStatus, answer.score, answer.submit_time AS submitTime FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN biz_student student ON student.student_id = answer.student_id INNER JOIN sys_user user ON user.user_id = student.user_id INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id WHERE answer.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND student.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND student.class_code = #{classCode} AND question.question_type = 'practical' AND answer.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY CAST(student.student_no AS UNSIGNED), student.student_no, answer.question_id
